svg.title: The end-to-end tests
svg.desc: run.sh starts a Compose project with Nextcloud, which has the checkout as a read-only Custom App, a mock of Paperless, mock_server.py, which also answers as other-host and fails for some terms, and the Chromium of Playwright with accessibility.mjs, axe-core, flow.mjs and settings.mjs. run.sh drives Nextcloud through occ, OCS, WebDAV and the routes of the settings and starts the browser; Nextcloud searches the mock, which writes each request into its journal before it answers, and run.sh reads the journal to check what reached Paperless; the browser opens the settings of the app, saves and disconnects there, and searches in the search dialog.
